title: PILOT v2 candidates: pre-registration (written before any candidate was generated or checked)
recorded_by: Claude Code session, candidates approved by ina823
split_intent: PILOT (development side); candidates are NOT registered in registry/instances_v1.jsonl by this step
predictions_status: hand-derived, not computed by running any code on these candidates

selection_rule.no_replacement: No candidate is replaced, dropped or re-seeded because of a result.
selection_rule.grade_is_fixed: NORMAL/STRESS never changes after this file; a missed target is recorded as target_met=false.
selection_rule.failures_are_kept: Failed or flagged candidates keep their full check record.
selection_rule.cbs: CBS is not run in this step.

check_criteria.validity: Every start and goal is inside the grid on a free cell; starts distinct; goals distinct.
check_criteria.agent_id: JSON agent_id equals list index for every agent.
check_criteria.coordinates: JSON [x, y] read through scenario_loader equals the generator's internal (row, col).
check_criteria.seed_reproducibility: Two generations with the same seed are byte-identical, also across PYTHONHASHSEED 0 and 1.
check_criteria.il_ood: il_compat.check_instance + quality_gate.classify_ood against registry/il_input_reference_v1.json; auto_fail stays False.
check_criteria.existing_relations: registry.relate against all 19 records (fingerprint, family, SUBMAP, NEAR_MAP, STRUCT_MATCH) plus Registry.evaluate(candidate, 'PILOT') and quality_gate.independence_check, in memory only.
check_criteria.candidate_relations: registry.relate and instance_fp equality for all 3 candidate pairs.
check_criteria.independence: No relation, automatic or manual, is approved as independent here: every automatic relation and every manual similarity is recorded as HOLD with final_decision null.
check_criteria.width1_cell_definition: A free cell whose two up/down neighbours are both wall-or-outside, or whose two left/right neighbours are both wall-or-outside.
check_criteria.normal_target: ood_class == IN_RANGE AND width1_cells == 0 AND num_agents <= 4.
check_criteria.stress_target: width1_cells > 0 AND max |goal_col| over start and reachable hints >= 13 AND num_agents == 6.

predicted.target_note: Blocks at (1,1) and (6,6) leave 2-cell gaps to the map edge. These count as width-1 under the strict definition above, so this NORMAL candidate is predicted to miss its target even if IN_RANGE. The definition is kept strict and the approved map is not changed.

manual_similarity_holds.basis: Both are open rooms; PV2C-001 adds four 2x2 wall blocks.
Both are a free ring around a central wall (width 2 around 3x5 vs width 1 around 1x1).
Cross-shaped traffic meeting at a centre, as in the intersection families.
Rooms joined through width-1 passages, as in the bottleneck families.
